# Engineering workflows & skills

Skills live in `.agents/skills/` (linked into `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code). Invoke one by name
(for example `/tdd`), or let the agent pick it from its description.

## Methodology: Matt Pocock skills
Not sure which skill fits? Start with `ask-matt`; it routes to the right one.

| Phase | Skills |
| --- | --- |
| Clarify intent | `grill-me`, `grill-with-docs`, `wait-what` |
| Specify & plan | `to-spec`, `to-tickets`, `domain-modeling`, `codebase-design` |
| Build | `tdd`, `implement`, `implement-spec`, `prototype` |
| Debug | `diagnosing-bugs`, `triage` |
| Review & ship | `code-review`, `pr`, `retro`, `handoff` |

## Discipline (apply to every change)
- `ponytail`: Smallest complete change; cuts over-engineering.
- `karpathy-guidelines`: Think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.
- `humanizer`: Strips AI writing tells from docs and copy.
